entry:
[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=Pixiv CLI OAuth Callback
NoDisplay=true
Exec="/tmp/pixiv \"quoted\" \$value\`\\tail" auth _callback %u
MimeType=x-scheme-handler/pixiv;

errors.xdg: xdg-mime is required for the desktop Pixiv callback handler
errors.gio: gio is required for the desktop Pixiv callback handler
errors.no_previous: no previous Pixiv URL handler is available
errors.delegate_gio: gio is required to open the previous Pixiv URL handler
errors.delegate_locate: could not locate previous Pixiv URL handler
errors.delegate_launch: could not open previous Pixiv URL handler
errors.unsafe_restore: cannot safely restore a previous Linux Pixiv URL handler
errors.nonregular: desktop integration state is not a regular file

restore_order: all snapshots attempted in stored order; duplicate paths last wins; errors joined in encounter order
home_missing_with_explicit_xdg: applications resolves from XDG_DATA_HOME; mimeapps snapshot list is empty

process.gio_failure: could not open previous Pixiv URL handler

legacy_disable.error: cannot safely restore a previous Linux Pixiv URL handler

repeat_legacy_registration_failure.reason: no stored snapshots means no rollback

native_paths.temporary_cleanup: restores original native paths and does not create replacement-character paths
native_paths.persistent_disable: restores initial config into lossy snapshot path; native config retains registration change and native desktop remains

invalid_endpoint_missing_home.ordering: validate relay before callback endpoint path resolution
